task.title: Step 01: ISSUE-FIXER root cause diagnosis for GH-767/ISS-0701 (REAL_BUG, NOT stale-evidence)
task.description: Diagnose why env01_test TC-ENV-01-03 fails with assertion error: existing tenant rows have tenant_type='production' and production_tenant_id IS NULL, but test finds rows that don't match. Run the test in isolation to capture the exact error. Read the test file and the env01_test helper. Identify the source of unclean state (e.g. clean_test_db.py doesn't drop all tenant schemas, or a parallel test left rows, or a migration added tenant_type enum). Produce a diagnosis report.

context.known_context: Test verifies all non-test tenant rows have tenant_type='production' and production_tenant_id IS NULL. Failure suggests leftover state from a previous test run that clean_test_db.py didn't clean, OR test's assumption about seeded data doesn't match, OR a migration changed tenant_type enum/defaults. 35/36 tests passed (1 failed).
context.stale_evidence_check: **CRITICAL** — Per the GH-758/GH-765 pattern, check first if the test ALREADY passes on main (i.e. GH-767's reported snapshot is stale). Run zig build test-integration-env01 on main BEFORE assuming a real bug. If the test passes, the diagnosis is PASS with resolution_via='duplicate-of-existing-fix' and steps 2-6 are skipped.

verification.test_repro_captured: zig build test-integration-env fails 35/36 on both main (dc0b60338) and feature/WF03-GH767-20260813 (same SHA) — TC-ENV-01-03 assertion at env01_test.zig:295 fails (count=1, expected 0)
verification.root_cause_identified: Harness fixture in tests/integration/helpers.zig:781 (INSERT default with tenant_type='test' AND production_tenant_id=00000000-...) contradicts TC-ENV-01-03's WHERE clause (env01_test.zig:280-285). The default row is excluded by neither slug!='default' nor slug NOT LIKE 'tc-env01-%'. Two individually-correct decisions (commit 106bb440 added the test; commit a2eea7a1 changed the fixture) were never reconciled.
verification.stale_evidence_check_done: PASS — stale-evidence pattern (GH-758/GH-765) explicitly ruled out. Test fails on main HEAD dc0b60338, deterministically, with BPM_TEST_INTEGRATION_JOB_CAP=1, no parallel binaries, fresh DB after clean_test_db.py.

result.summary: REAL BUG (not stale-evidence). TC-ENV-01-03 fails on main dc0b60338 because tests/integration/helpers.zig:781 (commit a2eea7a1, PR #393) deliberately sets the harness 'default' fixture to tenant_type='test' AND production_tenant_id=00000000-..., which TC-ENV-01-03's WHERE clause excludes by neither 'default' nor 'tc-env01-%'. Proposed fix: add 'slug != 'default'' (and parenthesisation) to env01_test.zig:280-285 WHERE clause — narrow test-file edit, no migration, no security impact.
